back.description: A short-lived URL of the card's back artwork.

card.description: The card's cards.sunshine.card record. Present only when the viewer may see it.

front.description: A short-lived URL of the card's front artwork.

index.description: The card's position in the draft.

errors.name: DraftNotFound
errors.description: There's no such draft, or the viewer may see none of it.

errors.name: CreatorUnavailable
errors.description: The creator's deck can't be reached right now.

cards.description: The draft's cards, in order. Asked for one card, just that one.

explainer.description: The draft's note to reviewers, in Markdown (CommonMark).

uri.description: The cards.sunshine.draft record, in its creator's deck.

card.description: Ask for just the card at this position.

main.description: Shows a draft set to someone asked to review it. Called through the viewer's PDS (service auth). The viewer sees the cards meant for them; the rest are just their positions. A draft the viewer may see none of answers DraftNotFound, as a missing one does.
